item.title: Do you remember your lucky number?
item.description:
I was never the kind of person who got nervous around people my age. That just wasn’t my thing. But then there was this one girl in class I couldn’t figure out how to talk to, so naturally, I just… didn’t.

And somehow, despite my complete lack of game, she was the one who started things. Which I then managed to completely fumble by ghosting her out of anxiety. Looking back, that might actually be one of the dumbest, most self-sabotaging things I’ve ever done.

item.title: Amor Fati
item.description:
“Amor Fati” — Latin for “love of fate” — is the practice of embracing whatever life throws at you and finding something useful in it.

Acceptance

Accepting the world as it is sits at the heart of Stoicism, and it comes down to one idea: control. A lot of what happens to us — other people’s behavior, our health, the economy — is simply outside our hands. The Stoics weren’t interested in pretending otherwise. Their argument was that fighting the unchangeable is just wasted energy, so point your efforts at what you can actually influence.

item.title: Hello World!
item.description:
I made this site as a personal outlet. Somewhere to learn, mess around, and dump whatever’s been sitting in my head.

It started when I got the GitHub Student Pack and figured — why dump stuff on Medium when I could just have my own thing? So I built it. Hugo, GitHub Pages, custom domain. Figured it out as I went. When it finally worked — that feeling of I made this was kind of hard to beat. I love it and here’s HEADSPACE.
